info.description:
GENERATED from the handlers' own wire types (internal/orchestrator/openapi.go). Do not edit by hand; regenerate with `go generate ./internal/orchestrator`. Maintained API documentation remains authoritative for intent: what an endpoint means and which refusal is which. This document says only what is on the wire.

The process and fs data plane is NOT here: it is Connect-RPC, and its machine-readable contract is proto/khora/transport/v1/transport.proto.

No authentication is described because the engine has none: it refuses any listener but loopback unless explicitly overridden, and authentication and TLS belong outside it.
info.title: khora engine control plane
